information.description:
Hanako Arasaka's personal bodyguard and one of the deadliest cyberninjas alive, with custom chrome most mercs never see. Honor drives him to fight alone, which a well-laid trap (with plenty of EMPs) might exploit.

Arasaka: The Japanese megacorp's security arm, from lobby guards to cyberninjas.

Stat block from Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis, unofficial content under R. Talsorian Games' Homebrew Content Policy. Portrait: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.

description.value:
Martial Arts (×2) is learned one Form at a time; each Form is its own Skill. Martial Arts Attacks are ROF2, ignore half armor and deal Brawling damage by BODY. Every Form has two Special Moves, and all Forms share Recovery.

Special Moves

  • Counter Strike: Your Turn; you took Brawling/MA/Melee damage since your last Turn. DV15: Aimed Shots against those attackers are at −5 instead of −8 this Turn.
  • Escape Hold: Your Turn; you're the defender in a Grapple. DV15: you're free.

Special Move resolution: DEX + Form Skill + 1d10 vs the target's DEX + Evasion + 1d10, or the DV listed. Special Moves can't be Aimed Shots unless they say so. "Once per Turn" means once per your Turn.

Recovery (shared): when you use Get Up, beat DV13 and it costs no Action. Not with a Broken or Dismembered Leg.

Sandayu Oda: w/ Sling; EQ + Smart; Expends 3 rounds per Single Shot Attack. Has Autofire (SMG 4) and only expends 6 rounds per Autofire.; x30 Improved Smart

Single Shot fires a 3-round burst; with fewer than 3 left, it empties the magazine for 3d6. Autofire uses 6 rounds instead of 10.
